title: Pouākai Crossing, Te Papa-Kura-o-Taranaki, Taranaki region
overview: Wind across the lower slopes of Taranaki Maunga – discover towering cliffs, a mighty waterfall, a sphagnum moss swamp and stunning views on this day walk version of the popular 2–3 day Pouākai Circuit.
Sections of this track can become impassable in winter conditions due to snow and ice. Check with North Taranaki Visitor Centre for latest track conditions.
No dogs. Other pets on conservation land rules.

Wind across the lower slopes of Taranaki Maunga – discover towering cliffs, a mighty waterfall, a sphagnum moss swamp and stunning views on this day walk version of the popular 2–3 day Pouākai Circuit.

North Taranaki Visitor Centre to Holly Hut
Time: 3–4 hr

Crossing begins on the Veronica Loop Track, starting at North Egmont. Follow the boardwalk past the Camphouse. From here the track leads past Ambury Monument and climbs a long series of steps. You will pass a track junction – take the track signposted towards Holly Hut.

Track. If you are walking in the other direction (from Holly Hut to North Egmont), this is a key decision-point: use it to assess the weather and decide whether to attempt the alpine section of the track. If conditions aren't favourable, you can return to Holly Hut or take Kōkōwai
Track junction. Turn left for a 5 minute walk to Holly Hut. Minarapa
Stream just prior to the hut does not have a bridge and can be impassable after heavy rain.

After around 1.9 km turn left onto Lepper Road Upper.
Continue on this road for 5.9 km until Egmont Road.
Continue on Egmont for around 10.4 km until the end of the road. North Taranaki Visitor Centre is at the end of the road.
This is a one-way track so you need to arrange transport to and from one end. Shuttle services are available – book directly with an operator. See Venture Taranaki for more information .

This is a 19km track that generally takes between 7 hr 30 mins and 9 hr 30 mins. The track passes through an alpine environment where extreme weather is common. You need good fitness and the right gear to do this track.

This is track is far more challenging in winter. You will need an ice axe, crampons, snow gaiters and goggles for the section of track between North Egmont and Holly Hut, along with the skills to use them.
, check the avalanche advisory and only tramp the track if you have the gear (avalanche transceiver, probe and snow shovel) and skills to manage the avalanche risk.

If you are tramping in winter or when there is snow, also take an ice axe, crampons, snow gaiters and goggles. If there is avalanche risk, carry an avalanche transceiver, probe and snow shovel. Check the NZ Avalanche Advisory

This monument on the Holly Hut Track is named after Arthur Hamilton Ambury who gave his life in a heroic attempt to save W E Gourlay who slipped on the ice on 3 June 1918. Both died in the fall over this bluff.

The premier 2–3 day tramp in Te Papa-Kura-o-Taranaki. It offers spectacular views of Taranaki Maunga and the surrounding countryside. The 25 km track passes through forest, alpine tussock fields and the unique Ahukawakawa.
